question: Can llama.cpp serve the embed cell, whose verification is cosine rather than byte_exact, given it is disqualified for byte_exact work?

gate.name: embeddingCosineThreshold
gate.note: Calibrated for two runs of the SAME implementation. Whether a different engine clears it was the open question.

result.margin: ~1000x below the 0.001 tolerance the gate allows

conclusion: llama_cpp_metal CAN serve a cosine-verified embed cell. Combined with the determinism sweep, the picture is cell-specific rather than engine-wide: llama.cpp is disqualified for byte_exact work on Metal and clears the embed gate comfortably.
blocking_structural_gap: The authority models wire_kind GLOBALLY per model: all-minilm-l6-v2 is declared 'hf' because candle serves safetensors. llama.cpp needs the GGUF of the same logical model. A cell cannot currently express 'this runtime serves this model from a different artifact format', and validateAdvertisedRuntimeCatalogRows actively refuses conflicting wire kinds for one model. Registering a llama.cpp embed cell therefore needs artifact format to move from the model to the (runtime, model) pair. That is a schema change, not a config edit, and it is the next real blocker.
